FUNCTION LEVEL_ORDER_TRAVERSAL ACCEPTS(root)
  result <- EMPTY LIST
  queue <- LIST [root]
  WHILE queue IS NOT EMPTY
    level <- EMPTY LIST
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF queue - 1
      node <- DEQUEUE(queue)
      level <- level + [node.value]
      IF node.left IS NOT NULL THEN
        ENQUEUE(queue, node.left)
      END IF
      IF node.right IS NOT NULL THEN
        ENQUEUE(queue, node.right)
      END IF
    END FOR
    result <- result + [level]
  END WHILE
  RETURN result
END FUNCTION
